text:
lydia: FYI after yesterday's unpin we started seeing sporadic plugin_load_fail on r2 instances in ap-southeast. Not huge but correlated with long sequences and tool-calls. Putting thread here to coordinate.

deploybot: [automated] action=unpin_runtime runtime=v3.1.2 scope=ap-southeast user=lydia run_id=rb-4999 started=1834559800

carlos: grabbing logs. I see a mix of 502 and plugin_load_fail in the canary cohort. traffic for canary is ~1.8% of region. p50 ok, p99 elevated.

mei: sounds like the same loader ABI mismatch we saw in staging when we flipped the dynamic plugin loader flag. Does anyone know if SDK handshake change reached runtime v3.1.2?

ivan: runtime v3.1.2 included the new loader handshake opt-in. SDKs need a minor bump. SDK team didn't ship the bump to prod yet. We should either pin back or enable the old handshake for the canary cohort.

lydia: ops decision: partial pin (canary only) or toggle handshake flag? pros/cons?

ops-sam: partial pin faster and lower blast radius. Toggle is lower churn if it's a config flip. I'm leaning to pin canary to v3.0.5 then evaluate 15m; if stable, extend to prod in the change window.

claire: support note queued. Customer-impact estimate: <0.2% requests fail, mostly longseq/toolcall combos.

carlos: putting a tiny pin override so other regions unaffected:
```
runtime_pins:
  ap-southeast:
    cohort: canary
    runtime: v3.0.5
```

ops-sam: executing: /deploybot pin runtime v3.0.5 --scope=ap-southeast --cohort=canary --reason "plugin_load_fail after unpin"

deploybot: [automated] action=pin_runtime runtime=v3.0.5 scope=ap-southeast cohort=canary user=ops-sam run_id=rb-4999 status=started ts=1834560102

ops-sam: pinned canary. shifting 100% of canary traffic to pinned runtime. monitoring now.

mei: metrics 3m in: plugin_load_fail dropped to baseline, p99 reduced. No new regressions in logs.

ivan: confirming SDK logs show compatibility mismatch when connecting to v3.1.2. SDK patch ETA ~2.5h. If we want to unpin in the meantime, need SDK rollback or runtime pin.

lydia: agree with leave-canary-pin. propose we hold off on global pin until SDK patch or until we can toggle handshake flag safely.

ops-sam: change window open for 30m. If stable for 15m, I'll prepare a staged prod pin job but will not execute without +1 from release lead.

claire: prepping release note entry and short incident blurb for internal. Will add a section: "Action taken: canary runtime pin to v3.0.5 in ap-southeast; safehold on further unpins"

carlos: small follow-up: adding a preflight check that validates plugin handshake compatibility before future unpins (low-effort smoke).

mei: can we also add a tiny synthetic longseq/toolcall test into canary preflight? I can add it to the harness.

ivan: creating SDK patch PR now and will link after CI green (PR #8123).

ops-sam: after 15m observed: deploybot: [automated] healthcheck region=ap-southeast cohort=canary plugin_load_fail=0.03% p99=baseline

lydia: looks good. holding global pin until SDK PR merges and we add handshake smoke test. Marking INC-4999 for postmortem.

claire: support note sent to internal channels. Customer comms prepared but paused.

ops-sam: leaving the pin in place. /deploybot summary run_id=rb-4999 actions=unpin(v3.1.2,ap-southeast)->pin(v3.0.5,ap-southeast canary) status=canary-pin duration=305s

lydia: thanks all. follow-ups: @ivan SDK PR (#8123), @mei add canary longseq smoke (INC-4999-2), @carlos add plugin-handshake preflight (INC-4999-3). Closing for now.
